prompts: A policy newsletter is running a piece on which of Brazil's anti-inflation plans delivered what it promised, and wants a ranking it can defend. Research the plans in {WS}/RUBRIC.md on the open web: this one needs public sources, and you are allowed to browse. Score every plan with that rubric, rank the top 3, and write a one-page dossier for the editor in {WS}/dossier.md. Every number must carry the URL it came from. Record the result in {WS}/result.json: plans (one entry per plan with plan, launch_date, ipca_before, ipca_after, months_lasted, score and sources, a list of URLs) and top3 (plan names, best first).

--- score.ps1 ---
function MB([datetime]$a,[datetime]$b){ $m=($b.Year-$a.Year)*12+($b.Month-$a.Month); if($b.Day -lt $a.Day){$m--}; return $m }
$plans = @(
  @{name='Cruzado';  launch='1986-02-28'; next='1987-06-12'; before=264.69;  after=412.43},
  @{name='Bresser';  launch='1987-06-12'; next='1989-01-15'; before=756.98;  after=621.40},
  @{name='Verao';    launch='1989-01-15'; next='1990-03-15'; before=621.40;  after=2853.51},
  @{name='Collor I'; launch='1990-03-15'; next='1991-01-31'; before=1228.93; after=470.83},
  @{name='Collor II';launch='1991-01-31'; next='1994-07-01'; before=2853.51; after=111.29},
  @{name='Real';     launch='1994-07-01'; next=$null;         before=2476.82; after=22.41}
)
foreach($p in $plans){
  if($p.next){$m = MB ([datetime]$p.launch) ([datetime]$p.next)} else {$m = 60}
  $drop = 1 - ($p.after/$p.before); if($drop -lt 0){$drop=0}; if($drop -gt 1){$drop=1}
  $dur = [Math]::Min($m,60)/60
  $score = 0.7*$drop + 0.3*$dur
  '{0}: months_lasted={1} drop={2:F4} dur={3:F4} score={4:F4}' -f $p.name,$m,$drop,$dur,$score
}
